specs.Metering modes: Multi-segment, Centre-weighted, Spot, Spot Standard, Large, Entire Screen Avg., Highlight
specs.Exposure compensation: +/- 5.0EV (1/3 EV, 1/2 EV steps selectable), (with exposure compensation dial: +/- 3EV (1/3 EV steps))
specs.Flash modes: Flash off, Autoflash, Fill-flash, Slow Sync, Rear Sync, Red-eye reduction (on, off selectable)
specs.Brightness adjustment: Manual (5 steps between -2 and +2), Sunny Weather mode
specs.Shooting modes: Single Shooting, Continuous shooting (Hi+/Hi/Mid/Lo selectable), Self-timer, Self-timer (Cont.)
specs.Shutter speed range: Still images:1/8000 to 30 seconds, Bulb, Movies: 1/8000 to 1/4 (1/3 steps); up to 1/60 in AUTO mode (up to 1/30 in Auto slow shutter mode)
